description: This file contains helper functions for extracting MAC addresses and handling configuration on a Phicomm K2T device, including loading configuration data from MTD partitions and parsing JSON data.

methods.name: k2t_config_load
methods.description: Loads configuration JSON data from the specific MTD partition, handling data size extraction and validation.

methods.name: k2t_get_mac
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address for a specified device info key by loading and querying the JSON configuration.
